# Clipper2 2.0.1

Unmodified C# sources from Angus Johnson's official release:
https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2/tree/Clipper2_2.0.1/CSharp/Clipper2Lib

Distributed under the Boost Software License 1.0; see LICENSE.txt.
TerritoryGeometry uses polygon union/difference to remove overlapping ownership
and retain holes. The app does not use the triangulation API.
